_comment: The transfer note as it travels (C2, C4, C8). It is an instance of the EXISTING Message record (Verbara.Platform.Conversations/Message.cs, serialized by ApiJsonContext: camelCase, enums as PascalCase strings, EntityId/TenantId as strings, block discriminator `$type`), returned by GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages (ConversationEndpoints.cs:114, IReadOnlyList<Message>) and by the supervisor history (SupervisorEndpoints.cs:174). What distinguishes it: direction is `System`, channel is the CONVERSATION's channel (never the hardcoded WebChat of SendCoachingNote, SupervisorEndpoints.cs:231-268), senderId is the transferring user's id, createdBy is `transfer:<userId>`, deliveryStatus is `Delivered`, and content has exactly one text block holding the trimmed note. The console renders direction System as the 'system' view-model (platform-message.ts:52); the SSE handler at conversation-store.ts:237 must map sender "System" the same way instead of 'customer' (C8). Never delivered to the customer: only SendCoreAsync reaches a connector, and WebChat has no customer-facing history route. Never labelled "Agent: " in the AI transcript: DefaultTypificationAiClassifier.cs:205 skips System rows (C4). A member that is null on the server is ABSENT from the JSON, not a literal null (WhenWritingNull at Program.cs:1454 and ApiJsonContext.cs:718, no override on Message; host design H11): `_omittedWhileNull` names the five a stored note never sets. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

history._bodyIsAnArray: the transfer note is one element, in createdAt order with the rest, oldest first, paged by limit (default 50) and offset (default 0) (host design H13)

blocks.text: Customer disputes the October invoice; the amount was already corrected once, please do not re-issue it.

sseEvent._comment: ConversationMessageEvent (Verbara.Platform.Core/PlatformEventBus.cs:100) published right after the message is saved, serialized by SseEndpoints.WriteEventAsync as `event: conversation.message` + `data: <json>`. Tenant broadcast, like every inbound customer message today (WebhookInboundProcessor.cs:112). The console reads conversationId, messageId, sender, text and timestamp (conversation-store.ts:237); the PushEvent envelope members it ignores (eventType, metadata) are present and unchanged.

data.text: Customer disputes the October invoice; the amount was already corrected once, please do not re-issue it.

invariants.writtenOnlyAfter: result.Success of TransferToQueueAsync / TransferToAgentAsync (ConversationEndpoints.cs:228-283); a refused transfer writes nothing
invariants.failedWrite: the 200 OwnershipResult still answers (the move is a fact); Warning log; audit note = failed
invariants.customerNeverSeesIt: a saved Message does not reach a connector; WebChatEndpoints.cs:44 is the only /sessions/{id}/messages route and it is a POST
invariants.aiTranscriptSkipsIt: DefaultTypificationAiClassifier.cs:205 (fed by ConversationEndpoints.cs:570) excludes direction System
invariants.senderSeesItOnlyInHistory: the Web removes the conversation from the sender's store on success (transfer-dialog.tsx:57); the receiver sees it in history when the page it reads holds the note (host design H13), or via the SSE event
